```{r}
#| include: false
library(knitr)
library(rmarkdown)
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(ggthemes)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(scales)
library(skimr)

theme_set(theme_ipsum()+
          theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="lightgray"),
                axis.title.x  = element_text(angle = 0,
                                            size = rel(1.5),
                                            margin = margin(10,0,0,0)),
                axis.title.y  = element_text(angle = 0,
                                            size = rel(1.5),
                                            margin = margin(0,10,0,0))
                )
          )
```


```{r}
nyc_dog_license <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_dog_license.csv')

nyc_zips_coord <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_zips_coord.csv')

nyc_zips_df <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_zips_df.csv')
```

```{r}
add_loc <- nyc_zips_coord |>
  left_join(nyc_zips_df)
```
```{r}
plot1 <- nyc_dog_license |>
  group_by(animal_gender, zip_code) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(total_dogs = sum(count), 
         prop_male = ifelse(animal_gender == "M", count/total_dogs, NA)) |>
  filter(animal_gender == "M") |>
  select(zip_code, prop_male)

plot_1 <- add_loc |>
  left_join(plot1)

ggplot(data = plot_1,
       aes(x = X,
           y = Y,
           group = zip_code,
           fill = prop_male)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "lightgrey",
               size = .3)

plot2 <- nyc_dog_license |>
  group_by(animal_gender, zip_code) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(total_dogs = sum(count), 
         prop_female = ifelse(animal_gender == "F", count/total_dogs, NA)) |>
  filter(animal_gender == "F") |>
  select(zip_code, prop_female)

plot_2 <- add_loc |>
  left_join(plot2)

ggplot(data = plot_2,
       aes(x = X,
           y = Y,
           group = zip_code,
           fill = prop_female)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "lightgrey",
               size = .3)


```
```{r}
ggplot(nyc_dog_license, 
       aes(x = borough,
           fill = animal_gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count", 
           position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "Male vs Female Licensed Dogs in Each Borough", 
       x = "Borough", 
       y = "Number of Dogs", 
       fill = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

This plot shows the number of female and male dogs in each borough. It can be seen that Manhattan has the largest amount of dogs licensed in it. 

```{r}
top_breeds <- nyc_dog_license |>
  group_by(breed_rc) |>
  summarise(count = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

ggplot(top_breeds, 
       aes(x = reorder(breed_rc, count),
           y = count,
           fill = breed_rc)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
 labs(title = "5 Most Common Dog Breeds", 
           x = "Dog Breeds", 
           y = "Number of Dogs") +
  theme_minimal () +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") 
```

```{r}
york <- nyc_dog_license |>
  group_by(zip_code, breed_rc) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(zip_code) |>
  mutate(total_dogs = sum(count), 
         prop_york = ifelse(breed_rc == "Yorkshire Terrier", count/total_dogs, NA)) |>
  filter(breed_rc == "Yorkshire Terrier") |>
  select(zip_code, prop_york)

add_loc <- nyc_zips_coord |>
  left_join(nyc_zips_df)

york_plot <- add_loc |>
  left_join(york)

ggplot(data = york_plot,
       aes(x = X,
           y = Y,
           group = zip_code,
           fill = prop_york)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "lightgrey",
               size = .3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno",
                       na.value = NA) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "panel") +
  labs(title = "Yorkshire Proportion")
```
